description:
Prices an order and finds the cheapest route across the QX order book and the QSwap pool, splitting the order across both when that is cheaper. Nothing is placed.

Returns an openInQMax link (when the order can be filled) that opens QMax with this order filled in, for the person to review and sign in their own wallet. Also returns the total in QU, the average price, each leg (venue, quantity, price range, fees, price impact), what each single market alone would cost, a plain-English line saying what the routing saved, and warnings. All amounts are QU; quantities are whole units. The quote is a snapshot: prices move, so re-quote before acting.

asset.description: Asset symbol, for example CFB or QDOGE (case does not matter). Use qmax_list_assets to find one.

qty.description: How many units of the asset

slippage_bps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (100 = 1%), applied to the limits in route[].execution

split.description: false prices the best single market only

name: qmax_get_quote
title: Quote a buy or sell across QX and QSwap
